hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '(.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath) // empty'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.html|*.css|*.scss|*.json|*.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in */electric-kar-front/*) d="$HOME/Documentos/tiendaOnline/electric-kar-front";; */electric-kar/*) d="$HOME/Documentos/tiendaOnline/electric-kar";; *) exit 0;; esac; "$HOME/.local/bin/pnpm" -C "$d" exec prettier --ignore-unknown --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
